description: In the sparsely populated wilderness, you suddenly heard strange arguing sounds...

mainQuestExcel.title: Villains
mainQuestExcel.description: In the sparsely populated wilderness, you suddenly heard strange arguing sounds...

dialogs.text: Hand your brother over! That heartless rat's betrayed us — the boss is practically frothing at the mouth!
H—How's that possible!? I thought you were all friends?
It's precisely because we were friends that he could betray us, Blanche. This is how the world works.
But... I don't know where he is either...
"I don't know either"? You really are Ley Lines... absolutely Ley Lines!
Ley Lines...?
Outdated! Ley Lines are outdated! Ley Lines shall be abandoned! The future belongs to the New Tide!
I... I... I don't know what you're talking about, but if he did something wrong... let me apologize on his behalf... Just please let me go...
Alright, sure. Let's take a vote.
Take a vote... on what?
Whether or not we should let you go, of course. Do you think the New Tide revolves around you?
That's right. A vote is necessary when opinions differ. Making arbitrary demands won't cut it. This is also how the world works, Blanche.
W—Wait!
Wait for what? You're gonna vote for letting the guy go, right? Fine. Let's make it one to zero in your favor.
But the New Tide commands me otherwise. Now it's a one-one draw.
Staying loyal to your friends is also how the world works. Sorry, Blanche. I'm with the New Tide on this one.
One to two! What an extraordinary twist of fate!
You... scoundrels! I haven't agreed to anything!
Try to understand the situation, would you, girl? You're just one, and guess what? One is completely useless when it's two against one!
Yup. The principle of "majority rules" is not only how the world works, but also a fundamental part of "order."
Now, you better spit it out! Where is the traitor hiding?!
Do I get a vote?
And Paimon, too!
Oh? Hey there, friends. What a coincidence that we should meet here in the wilderness. So, how will you be voting?
Hey, wait! Who are you two? Don't act like we're friends. Has no one taught you the most important thing is keeping a respectful distance from other people?
You're one to talk about keeping distance, when you're the ones bothering others! You've got some nerve!
Hey, calm down, little one. Y'know what, it's pretty cool how you're just floating around! Why not work under me? I'll call you the Trendy Flyer!
No way! Paimon's friend is way cooler than you... Hey! You're messing Paimon's train of thought up! Let the kid go right this second!
Haha! You're not part of my gang, so why should I listen to you?
That said, it's two to two now... somehow.
Hey, Wolfhook, what are you doing, accepting votes from people we don't even know?
Where's the voting button? Someone help me vote for letting the kid go.
Now it's two to three. Another extraordinary twist of fate.
Stop, Wolfhook! I thought we were friends! Which side are you on?
On the side of majority rule.
The minority must obey the majority, right? This is how the world works.
What the... Seriously? Why did I even come to you for help? Darn it... Hey, Trendy Flyer, I'll let you win this time, but...
Listen up, girl! Go tell your brother to get in touch with us immediately if he doesn't want to bite it, you hear me?
Goodbye, my new voter friends. Bye, Blanche. Oh, and, if it's possible, please ask your brother to contact us. Thanks.
Well, they're finally gone. Those two are so weird. Oh, are you okay, kid?
I—I'm fine... Thank you... and that floating miss over there.
#Call me Paimon! This is {NICKNAME}.
Th—Thank you... I am Blanche. You two must be great adventurers, then? I... I'll definitely visit the Adventurers' Guild to thank you!
But I have more important things to do right now... My brother's gone missing. I need to find him, but once I do, I will go visit you at the Adventurers' Guild!
So... Sorry, I need to go. Thank you again!
Hey, wait up! Oh... She's gone... Why is she in such a hurry?
#{NICKNAME}, let's help her. It's too dangerous for a kid to be out there alone. What if she can't find her brother?
She doesn't seem to want to involve us.
Must be because she doesn't have money... She knows hiring adventurers costs a lot of Mora. But those guys won't let her off the hook this easily... So we have to help!
#{NICKNAME}, how about Paimon pays your fee? You can take it from Paimon's food fund!
And have you asked the food fund first?
P—Paimon did...! It said... said, "Please use me how you see fit!"
I don't remember ever saying that.
Hey! You're not Paimon's food fund... Well, you're not just that...
Paimon will fund your food supply once she gets rich! But first, let's stop making jokes... The girl needs our help!
Alright. Staying loyal to your friends is how the world works, after all.
Hehe. Paimon knew it. You were already planning to help, weren't you? Let's hurry up and catch up to her before she gets too far away!
Or should we let our fists do the talking?
#Quit pestering me, or it's no more {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} Nice Traveler for you.

flow.stepDescription: Catch up with the little girl, Blanche

dialogs.text: Hey there, kiddo! Why are you sitting here?
#You're the ones from before... {NICKNAME} and Paimon...
Heheh. Good memory. We're here to help you find your brother!
Th—Thank you... but I'm worried that...
Don't worry! We won't charge you. We just can't stand idly by when someone needs our help!
It's not that... My brother left me some money. I'm just worried that...
Are you worried about your brother being a Treasure Hoarder?
Yes...
You're good people. I can see that... But my brother and those two were... friends.
I know being a Treasure Hoarder isn't an honest job... I don't want to drag you into their business...
I know how you feel. I'm also looking for my family.
Huh?
That's why finding your brother should be our first priority.
Yup! We'll find your brother first, and then we'll ask him what happened! See? There's nothing to worry about! We're the ideal people to help you! Just leave it to us!
#{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} and Paimon... Y—You really are different. I see... Then, thank you for the help... Here's what happened...
A month or so ago, my brother happened to acquire a potion formula that could be very valuable. It's said to be the work of the Fontaine Research Institute, and is known as Pure Water.
After the Institute exploded, many things were scattered in the wilderness, and my brother often roamed around that area. That's how he picked it up.
He came across it by himself?
No... Maybe... He might've been with a group of people... But my brother must've kept it for himself...
And that's why his friends called him a traitor... That's the only reason I can come up with, anyway...
No wonder those two Treasure Hoarders were looking for him... But why are all of you here? Are there any leads here?

Well, this used to be the backyard of the Fontaine Research Institute, which was home to various plant nurseries. It's said that the potioneer who created the Pure Water once lived here in seclusion to work on it.

The formula was written without too much detail or context, and contained the names of some raw ingredients... but my brother couldn't understand them, so he came here looking to see if there were any relevant manuscripts left...
And then he disappeared?
Yeah... From the look of this place, it's been long abandoned, with no nurseries in sight. Even this house is empty... Where could my brother have gone...?
Don't worry, we'll find him. Oh, speaking of which, what's your brother's name, Blanche?
I—It's "Tricky Bulle Fruit." He's also one of the Fruity Order's operatives.
Huh? That name's... a bit of a surprise... but not really... Anyway, let's try calling out to him from around here.
Hey! Tricky Bulle Fruit! Where are you?
Tricky Bulle Fruit! Your sister is looking for you!
Tricky Bulle Fruit! Squeak if you can hear us!
S—Stop that Ms. Paimon... We might draw the attention of his enemies...
M—Makes sense... Sorry! Paimon forgot that we're not the only ones looking for him.
Squeak!
Huh? What was that? Did you hear that? Paimon heard something!
I heard it!
Me too.
Let's look around. Paimon's certain someone's hiding nearby!
Are you worried that we might be Treasure Hoarders?
No, you can't be...
Hey! Hello? Did someone say something? Are you hiding inside? Uh...
Doesn't seem like it...
Yeah, Paimon thinks so too. Seriously... Wait! Y—Y—You... Who are you!? You said something again!
Brother!? It's my brother's voice! Brother? Are you inside?
I'm not anyone's brother. I just borrowed that guy's voice.
What!? You're Tricky Bulle Fruit, aren't you!? Stop this act, right now! Your sister's worried to death!
I told you, it's not me. Come inside and you'll understand.
(Try opening the door.)
You push the door, but the door pushes back. You were hoping that it would open its heart to you, but the lock rejected you.
It's not gonna squeak open! It won't open, squeak~!
Hey! Stop acting like a kid! Just hand us the key already!
Doors come in all shapes and sizes, those that can open have a key, and those that can't go without, just like the situation you're facing right now.
Shall I show you how violence opens all doors?
The poor world gave birth to a poor child, and the poor child has learned poor skills...
Violence, destruction, conflict... They shall have exceptionally poor effect on me.
Brother... No... My brother wouldn't say such things. You're not my brother! Who are you?
Oh, who's this? What a pure little princess! Ah, even the Bluecrown Finch would dance for you.
Allow me to introduce myself. I'm an apostle of the World of Intense Purity.
I've descended into this darn cabin now, so just call me the Cabin of Intense Purity.
As for your brother, that vile man known as Tricky Bulle Fruit, his vileness is beyond your ken.
And upon entering a pure world, the vile one found no escape.
Sorry, a what world, again? What are you talking about?
My brother isn't that kind of person... Wait, he's gone to another world? Do you mean... he's dead?
The world has wrapped itself around him, just like resin wraps around a worm. He's merely trapped.
D—Does another world really exist?
#What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Do you believe that? You know better than us when it comes to other worlds.
It's possible.
U—Um... Mr. Cabin of Intense Purity, please tell me how I can get my brother back from that world.
I merely know how to lead people there, but I don't know how to guide someone back.
In that case, what's your objective?
Countless are the wise, but you are the rarest amongst them. I spoke in haste when there were more important things to do.
The person is trapped by the world, and the world is infected by that person, and thus has the pure white path fallen into darkness.
Therefore, I cannot embark on the road back home, and instead, require your assistance.
Huh... Paimon didn't think the guy we were looking for was such a big troublemaker...
But do not forget that to help me is to help yourselves. Once everything is done, I shall "accidentally" leave a "key" behind...
And you shall unexpectedly obtain said "key"... due to blind chance, of course.
Will that allow me to bring my brother back?
I dare not guarantee your success, but this is the only way to the other side.
What? You can't even guarantee that? Can you at least tell us how we're supposed to help you, then? And no bad stuff, we don't do that!
I swear in purity's name that I have never committed any evil, not from the moment of my birth.
I only require a few Pure Pinecones. They are all I need to repair the contaminated path.
Pure Pinecones? Paimon has never heard of those...
They are precious fruit planted by a potioneer, and can only be found around this cabin.
Why are they so effective, you ask? Why, they are miraculous herbs watered with Pure Water.
P—Pure Water!? Isn't that the potion formula my brother obtained!?
Now Paimon remembers. The potioneer of Fontaine Research Institute. Did he...
That previous potioneer is, indeed, the last lucky soul to have visited the World of Purity.
If we're talking about the fortune he obtained in that paradise, then it is this thing we call Pure Water. This cabin I now live in was once his residence.
Oh! So others have been to that world too, have they?
#{NICKNAME}, Paimon was a little skeptical about the truth of his words, but what he said matches what Blanche has told us. The cabin is where the potioneer used to live in seclusion...
I always speak the truth. No judge would ever accuse me of deceit.
#Now that we know my brother's whereabouts, I'll definitely find him. But Paimon, {NICKNAME}, I don't want to put you at risk...
#Don't say things like that. We've already decided to help you, right, {NICKNAME}?
Well, in for one Mora, in for the lot...
Hehe! Paimon knew you'd say that!
I see. In that case, could you please take this simple test of mine?
What? A test? You didn't say anything about that! Don't you trust us!?
After seeing all of you, and especially after witnessing how valiant this blonde knight is, I took the liberty of inwardly labeling you as beyond question.
But to be honest, the Paradise of Purity is no children's playground. If you lack strength, your lives may be in danger.
If the princess ceases to be happy, then I shall never be happy either. So, please make a display of sufficient strength, dear knights.
It is a power that springs from purity, and it can control the purest source of water in the world. Thus, the people of this world call it the power of Hydro.
#Water is just Hydro! That's nothing difficult for {NICKNAME}.
I see you're willing to follow my plan. In that case, let us get straight to it!
Please observe these simple mechanisms carefully and light them up with the power of Hydro.
An adventure to another world would be quite interesting.
Hehe! That's our greatest adventurer for ya!

flow.stepDescription: Look for where the suspicious voice is coming from

Amazing, Golden Knight. The tiny machine didn't last a minute against you.
#You really are amazing, {NICKNAME}.
See? Paimon said there was nothing to worry about.
Then please find me Pure Pinecones. It's a miraculous fruit born of this place.
And please, do remember that I need a total of five.
Alright, alright, we've got it. Seriously, why do we have to do something as trivial as searching for pinecones?
*sigh* I apologize, but I lack hands and feet. I'm just a pitiful, lowly little cabin.
Let's split up, Paimon. It'll speed things up. The sooner we find the pinecones, the sooner we'll get to see my brother. I'm heading off first, alright?
Don't go too far, Blanche! Don't leave our sight!
I know! I'll search over here on the east side.
I've found one! We can do this!
Blanche, how many pinecones have you found? We have three over here.
I've only found one... But I've searched the entire area...
We have three and Blanche has one, so that makes four. Five minus four equals... equals... one!
So we only need one last pinecone. But there doesn't seem to be any nearby... What should we do?
Should we speak to Cabin about it?
Hmm... That guy doesn't seem that easy to trick...
He! Hehe! Hehehe! Hey, you over there! Your savior, the New Tide, is here!
What are you doing here again!? What happened to maintaining a sense of distance!?
Hmph! You're looking for those crappy pinecones, right? And you're looking for more, right? Well, I have the rest. You want them?
Wait! How did you know we're looking for the pinecones?
Hey. Trendy Flyer, do you want it or not?
You've been following us?
Oh Ley Lines, is that the only reason you can think of?
Who was it shouting "Tricky Bulle Fruit" all over the shop, huh? The entire mountain heard you. Even children came over out of curiosity!
And I'm one of the Five Great Operatives of the Fruity Order. Do I look like a child to you?
Ah! Sorry, Blanche... Guess Paimon really did draw the attention of your brother's enemies...
What? Enemies? I don't have time for this nonsense! I'm here to do business with you.
I may not have heard your conversation with the person in the cabin, but since Blanche is also helping him, I'm certain it's connected to Bulle Fruit somehow.
Tell me what the person in the cabin said and I'll give you the rest of the pinecones. It's really simple, isn't it?
Or maybe I can take the pinecones from you.
Oh, now you're making me angry. I'm one of the Five Great Operatives of the Fruity Order. Do I look like a child to you? Would I carry such items with me?
Hmph! You wouldn't believe us even if we told you! It's not something an ordinary person would understand!
Don't look down on me! Ordinary people would never understand the teachings of the New Tide!
Alright then, if you don't mind being scared to death! That cabin isn't human!
Wh—What?
This concerns another world.
Another world?
Hear that? Unbelievable, huh!? "How could there be another world?" Paimon bets that's what you're thinking right now.
Are you kidding me? Why would I think that? The New Tide is exactly that!
Wait! The New Tide is a world too? H—Have you... been there?
I haven't, but so what? I think it exists. Got a problem with that?
You should discard all your Ley Line thoughts. Let me tell you this. The order of this world is slipping away, and that's why new worlds are being born.
This is also why Treasure Hoarders are born when there is an imbalance in wealth. Treasure Hoarders exist to bring balance back to wealth!
The Ley Lines have contaminated everyone, and so the New Tide shall be born; the darkness has contaminated everyone, and so a world of light shall be born. That's how things are.
So yeah, I wouldn't be surprised even if you told me there are other worlds.
For a person so full of nonsense, you're really good at accepting new things... Anyway, we've told you what you wanted, so it's time to hand over the pinecones!
Hey! We're not done! What about Bulle Fruit? That's what I'm concerned about!
We've already made our show of goodwill.
Th—Then let's both take a step back. I'm not interested in the worlds beyond the New Tide, and I don't want to know anything else either. I only have a single request.
When you find that darn Bulle Fruit, tell him to come to see me as soon as possible. He knows how to find me. Deal?
No! If you're planning on harming him, then I would rather never find my brother.
Oh Ley Lines... You silly girl. We're not the ones hunting your brother, it's someone else. Don't you realize that your brother's life is hanging by a thread right now?
Didn't you say your boss was super mad?
Oh yes, very mad indeed! So mad, in fact, that he's dispatched a very formidable woman named Ruthless Calla Lily.
Ruthless... Calla Lily? I've heard of her before from my brother. He said that she never fails.
Yes, she's as real as an assassin gets, and the scariest one out of us Five Great Operatives.
No matter where Bulle Fruit goes, she will catch him in the end, and will either cut him in half or skin him alive. She never fails!
And you... Are you helping my brother? I thought he took what you were looking for?
Yes, he betrayed us. Betrayal is despicable, but it's also very cool, isn't it?
I've known him longer than you have, and I know he doesn't take reckless risks.
We can't allow him to die until we know how he came up with such a cool idea.
I told Wolfhook immediately after I found out. We need to find Bulle Fruit before that scary woman does.
What will your boss think when he finds out?
That's none of your business, we'll deal with it the New Tide way. Anyway, think about my proposal. I have nothing to hide.
If what you said is true, it seems like it should be okay. Paimon's just afraid that you're lying...
Hey. Unlike Bulle Fruit, I'm no liar!
Wh—Where did your companion go, then? Where is... What's his name, Wolfhook? Did you fire him because he didn't help you last time?
How old are you again, Trendy Flyer? If I could hear you when you were screaming by Cabin, surely she could, too! She must be nearby.
I asked Wolfhook to stand guard in the area. We will not give Bulle Fruit into her hands. Do you understand now?
...Alright, we'll trust you this one time.
That's right. Now, take the pinecones. Remember, if you see him, tell him to come to see me at once!
Hey, you just said that you wouldn't carry these things with you!
That was a bluff, of course. What was I going to do if you attacked me, Trendy Flyer? I mean, you can fly!
What if you dived from above and messed up my hair?
Paimon wouldn't do that! ...Unless you're hiding Mora in your hair, or something.
Stop yapping. She'll be here any minute. Wolfhook and I might be able to stall her for a while, but you shouldn't waste your time here!
Thank you, Zaytun Peach. And thank Wolfhook for me! We are off!
Oh, go on, move it!
This is also betrayal, isn't it?
Don't push it.
You've been eavesdropping?
Could we substitute it with something else?
Cabin! Hey, Cabin! We have your Pure Pinecones!
Mr. Cabin, are you there?
(Knock on the door.)
That's strange... Why isn't it responding? That guy didn't just leave on his own, right!?
Huh? Hurry, over here.
Huh? That sounded like it came from behind the cabin...

flow.stepDescription: Go behind the cabin to find the voice
Talk to the strange spot the voice is coming from

dialogs.text: Come closer, please, so I can have a good look at you.
Uh... Hello, are you the one who said that? Mr... Big Wine Barrel?
I'm not a wine barrel. I'm the Crucible of Intense Purity.
You're obviously a wine barrel! You look nothing like a crucible!
Ah! A princess and two knights, I see. Well, now, allow me to offer my humble greetings to such pure individuals as your august selves.
Hello, M—Mr. Crucible, we're here to see Mr. Cabin of Intense Purity. Do you know where it's gone?
I do, I do. I've always been aware of your troubles, dear princess, and I've been waiting for the pinecones.
Cabin has gone ahead, and it will be able to repair the contaminated path with said pinecones.
Oh, so it's another one of you... Your world has quite a few apostles, huh? Anyway, we've found the pinecones, but how do we pass them to you?
Just push them through the hole above me. It is the path that leads to the World of Purity.
And then? Cabin promised to leave us a "key." Paimon's sure it's mentioned that to you, right?
Cabin is a fair and kind person with a good temper. Be it man, woman, or anyone else, Cabin would never allow anyone to offer a tribute to it.
Yet you've done Cabin a great kindness, so why would it refuse to part with a single key?
#The people of your world are so strange, and you're so good with words... Anyway, let's put the pinecones in, {NICKNAME}.

flow.stepDescription: Place the Pure Pinecones into the top of the crucible

dialogs.text: They should be placed here.
Ah, I've missed this pure taste. Now, allow me to fulfill our pledge.
Please get a container from over there and collect the medicine that shall be squeezed from the outlet beneath me.
When dusk arrives and the sun goes to sleep, drink the medicine, and you shall enter the World of Intense Purity.
So the medicine squeezed from the pinecones is the "key"... That really is something. But where's the entrance?
You, flying knight, may be a master of many skills, but unfortunately, neither hearing nor memory is one of them.
The entrance is through the hole above me. I won't repeat myself again.
#Hey! It was just a tiny lapse of memory. A tiny one! Hmph! Never mind that. Let's go get our "key," {NICKNAME}.
The liquid pours out of the outlet and quickly fills the container. You have obtained the "key."
Finally, everything has been done perfectly, thanks to you, pure ones.
I'm a little reluctant to say goodbye, but even worlds say farewell, sooner or later.
Thank you! Thank you Mr. Crucible of Intense Purity... And Mr. Cabin of Intense Purity, who left in advance... Once I find my brother, I hope we can thank you in person again.
It's my greatest honor to hear such moving words from you, pure princess.
As such, I must give you some personal advice. The World of Purity only welcomes knights. It would be rather unwise for you to go forth into that place, Princess.
As for the reason... Forgive me, for I cannot say.
What a strange rule...
We'll need to think about this carefully.
But... I'm the one who's trying to save my brother, so I should be the one taking the risks. If you go instead of me, I'd feel awful...
It's alright. Even that big crucible said that world welcomes knights. We'll be fine, but it may be more dangerous with you there.
But...
No buts. Ask the big crucible if you're still worried about us. Crucible! Crucible!

flow.stepDescription: Drink the potion and go to the World of Intense Purity

dialogs.text: Ah... The wind sure is howling today... Huh? What's that? Don't mind me, I'm just a tourist...
Ah... The wind sure is howling today...

flow.stepDescription: Go to the World of Intense Purity

dialogs.text: You pull open the tiny opening and leap inside. Only darkness awaits below.
Some time passes, and then you hear a soft voice...
Ugh... Paimon's so dizzy... It feels like she's been sleeping for ages! Whoa! It's so dark here! And so wet! Did we fall into water?
#{NICKNAME}, are you alright? Paimon's got your hand, and it's so cold. C'mon, she'll warm it up for you.
Thank you, Paimon. I'm fine.
Have we arrived in the World of Intense Purity? Why is it so dark and cold and damp in here? It isn't the white, bright, and warm world that Paimon imagined at all!
Huh? Is someone singing? Is anyone there!?
Hey, knights! You're finally awake. How was your nap?
Not good... Is this the World of Intense Purity?
The World of Intense Purity? Pfft! Bahahahaha!
You actually believed that? Are you kids? How could there be another world? This is hilarious!
Wh—What? We were deceived? Wait... How do you know all of this? Who are you!?
Don't you remember my voice? Seriously, we're at least partially acquainted, aren't we?
"You, flying knight, may be a master of many skills, but unfortunately, neither hearing nor memory is one of them"...
You're the Crucible of Intense Purity!
You're Cabin of Intense Purity!
Hehe! I'm the Crucible and the Cabin both. It's always been me! I've been hiding here, hoodwinking folk. Oh, right. The people on the street know me by another name — Tricky Bulle Fruit.
Tricky Bulle Fruit? Y—You're Blanche's brother! You're terrible! Where the heck are we?
So we're actually inside the wine barrel?
Obviously! Did you really think that you would travel to another world like in those novels?
Guess you Hydro-controlling folk really are as naive as children! No wonder you're an ingredient for Pure Water.
What ingredient? You plan to turn us into an ingredient?
You already are. You've been soaking in the barrel for half a day. According to the formula, the power of Hydro should have been isolated by now.
I wouldn't have been able to mix Pure Water without the power of Hydro you possess. Otherwise, who knows when I'd have been able to restore this formula.
Oh, I know you're strong, but you can forget about breaking out of this barrel. After all, you drank the "key" that I prepared for you.
It's actually a drug. You must be feeling absolutely weak right now, huh?
How could you? You sneaky little... sneak! And to think that we were actually helping Blanche look for you! And now you're going to treat us like this, just for that formula?
Hmph! Stubborn until the end, huh? You can trick my sister, but you can't trick me. I betrayed the boss, and the boss isn't kind enough to spare me!
You're the assassins my boss sent after me, right? You may be skilled, but unfortunately, your brains are lacking. It's time to become ingredients for my potion!
...You've misunderstood.
The real assassins are still out there.

Don't even think about lying your way out of this! My sister is the only person in the world who would lend a helping hand to a stranger without expecting anything in return! That's the greatest flaw in your plan!
What we said is true! Blanche will corroborate it! And we even met one of your compatriots! They're the ones who are really hunting you!
Wait! Where did she go? Was she in cahoots with you? Did she deceive us too?
Don't you insult her! Don't you ever use that word to describe her! She's purer than all of you combined!
That silly girl actually jumped in after the two of you... And I even warned her not to come here... Seriously...
Luckily, I was watching, and I immediately sent her outside. But her body is too weak, so she should still be unconscious right now.
Then you'll know the answer once she wakes up. We're really not here to hunt you down.
Brother!? Brother! You're back! When did you get back? I missed you so much!
S—Sis... When did you wake up? You should be resting!
I'm so happy that you're back. I had a dream where you were singing to me, and then I woke up to you standing before me... I'm so, so very happy!
#{NICKNAME} and Paimon rescued you, didn't they? Where are they?
What? Who are those people?
They're nice people who were helping me! D—Did they get left behind in that world? Did you not see them? How could this...
D—Don't cry... Have you ever considered that they might've been sent to hunt me down?
Hunt you down? No way! We met a... colleague of yours earlier. They said that someone known as the Ruthless Calla Lily is after you!
Blanche explains how you met.
How can this be? She's coming for me? D—Did I really make a mistake?
#Anyway, if {NICKNAME} and Paimon really have been left behind in that world, then we must rescue them!
Ahem...
Blanche! We're over here!
Wait, I hear them! Oh, that's great news! Where are you? Are you inside Mr. Crucible?
Yeah, we're inside Mr. Crucible.
No, there's no Mr. Crucible.
Are you stuck? Give me a moment, let me see if I can pull you out from the opening!
Huh? There's no Mr. Crucible? What does that mean?
Wait... Give me a moment. U—Um... Forgive me... I was wrong... I'll release you immediately.
What? What are you saying?
The young man with orange hair quickly pulls you out of the wine barrel and starts explaining everything to his sister.
Wh—What... How could you do that!?
The evil consider all others to be evil.
Yeah! How could you?
Paimon's gonna throw you inside for three days and nights!
Brother! Apologize now! Or... or I'll never forgive you!
I—I'm sorry... Maybe you can vent by hitting me? I—I won't fight back...
#Just do it, {NICKNAME}! He really went too far... I truly don't know how to apologize to you...
Really?
Perfect.
Give him a good beating! Mess up his hair!
Go on! Don't worry about hitting me too hard... I'll drink some fresh Pure Water, so I'll be able to take quite the beating!
Hey! Are you trying to use this as an opportunity to test that potion of yours? You sly fox!
Your apology doesn't feel very sincere now!
No... Not at all. It's just that if this potion's effects are as the legends say, then I can make another for you. Is that enough sincerity for you?
Whoa! Really? That does sound pretty nice! How much Mora is it worth?
I hear the inferior version of it sells really well in the Fortress of Meropide... so I'm sure the original will definitely sell for even more Mora.
So you betrayed your companions for Mora?
I have my reasons. If any of them bother you, feel free to include those when hitting me.
The orange-haired young man walks over to the wine barrel, extracts some of the potion made from you soaking in the barrel, and then gulps it all down.
Hey... Wouldn't that stuff be considered our, uh, bath water? Is our bath water that amazing?
Do it! I'm ready!

flow.stepDescription: Teach Tricky Bulle Fruit a lesson

dialogs.text: #Watching that beating got Paimon's spirits back up, that's for sure. {NICKNAME}'s hands were icy cold in the wine barrel, and it was all your fault!
Whew... You really didn't hold back. I'm not complaining, though, I'm praising you! You're really strong.
C'mon, brother, please, just... stay silent!
So that's all there is to Pure Water?
No, something seems to be off about it. I've tried the inferior version, but this performed even worse than that. Did something go wrong with the production?
Ah! It feels like Paimon's 100,000 Mora payday just became a mere 10,000...
I've compared all the ingredients with the Potioneer's manuscript, so there's definitely no problem there. Besides the ingredient extracted from the two of you, that is...
Don't push the blame on us! How could it be our problem? W—We're pure enough!
No! No! That's not what I mean. In the manuscript, that ingredient is known as the "power of water," so I thought it meant Hydro...
So that's why you wanted to test us with those Hydro mechanisms while you were disguised as the Cabin...
I'm embarrassed to say that there may be an error in my understanding... But what does the "power of water" represent? I must figure it out.
Have you forgotten that you're still being hunted?
I know! Calla Lily never fails... But...
I cannot stop here. I must... I must finish it... I have no other choice...
Paimon doesn't quite get you...
Isn't the "power of water" just the power of water?
The power of water? Only Hydro holds power, right? What other kind of power could water hold?
You've told me so many stories, brother, so you must know that in many stories, water itself is power.
Water itself?
That's right, just like the story about the potioneer which you told me when I was young.
The story about obtaining Pure Water from the World of Purity? But... wasn't that just a lie?
That's the only part I made up... The rest has been passed down by word of mouth for generations.
They say that there was once a handsome but eccentric young man in the Fontaine Research Institute, a prodigy in potions and alchemy.
But as the Institute's focus was not on potions and alchemy, and due also to his slightly withdrawn and narcissistic tendencies, he was somewhat ostracized.
Later on, he came to these mountains to live in seclusion and continue his research, and he invented many miraculous potions.
Unfortunately, none of them were preserved, because he poured them all into the ground.
He poured them all away!?
Yes, that's what the stories say, and that's why he's considered weird. Maybe all geniuses are like that?
But there was a turn of events later on, and some say that it was the work of the Hydro Archon, who couldn't bear to see those legendary potions just vanish.
As more and more potions were poured there, they gradually formed a small pond. The potioneer was so amazed by the pond's formation that he sat nearby and admired it all day.
No one knows if he was indulging in his own masterpiece or his own reflection in that masterpiece of his.
That's so intriguing! What happened next?
After that, the young man would immerse himself in the pond all day. But one day, he accidentally slipped into the pond and drowned in his own creation.
Some time later, a little blue and white flower emerged from the center of the pond, its beauty rivaling that of the potioneer.
Oh... That's such a sad story... Wait... <color=#00E1FFFF>A pond with a little flower</color>? Hasn't Paimon seen a place like that?
Are you serious? I mean, I didn't make this up, but it's still just a legend.
#But Paimon really has seen it before... Ugh, but she can't remember where! Do you remember, {NICKNAME}?
In the World of Intense Purity.
Hmph! Guess you don't believe Paimon, huh? But she really has seen it, you know!
I—I know! We passed by a small pond like that while gathering the pinecones! There was a little flower at the center of the pond...
R—Really? That's just a story! Are you sure? I never noticed.
You overlooked all of that because you were so focused on targeting us. That's why only Blanche remembers.
It seems I really... Sigh, forget it. Shall we head over and have a look? Perhaps the key to the "power of water" lies in that pond.
I think I remember.
It's alright. We've accepted your apology.

flow.stepDescription: Eliminate the monsters around the pond

dialogs.text: It's finally over. There were so many monsters! What attracted them?
They might have spawned here, which means that there might be some kind of wonderful power in this area.
You see the little flower in the middle of the pond? It's... just like in the legends.
It doesn't look that different from an ordinary flower...
But the dew drops on it are so shiny! They're more beautiful than dew you find elsewhere.
Let's collect some.
Dew drops that have formed by absorbing essence... Maybe that's the truth behind the power of water?

flow.stepDescription: Collect dew from the center of the pond

dialogs.text: I can feel the power within these dew drops just by looking at them. I have a strong feeling, now, that our next mixture will be a success. Let's go back and give it a try.
Great! 10,000 Mora now feels like 100,000!
I'll start mixing now. Just wait a moment.
The orange-haired young man starts working in front of the console, and a smile of joy soon appears on his face.
We've done it! We've done it! I don't even need to try it out. I just know! This is so much better than the rip-offs in the Fortress of Meropide!
Whoo! Our work finally paid off!
#Great! You're amazing! So are you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!
No, you contributed the most, Blanche.
Yes, if she hadn't remembered the story and the pond...
That's nothing, brother. I remember everything you've ever said.
Thank you, both of you, for not holding a grudge. I made two copies of the formula as I promised, as my apology.
Nice, you kept your word. We'll gladly take it! That said, though, we only need one.
And there's one for you, Blanche.
Why? You can just take some. It's not like I'm going anywhere, right?
No, we can't stay together forever. You have a bright future — that's not something you should waste here.
Take the complete formula to the new Fontaine Research Institute. If they don't think it's important enough, then go somewhere further out.
Go to the Akademiya in Sumeru, or Liyue, or even Mondstadt. Someone will appreciate it enough to take you in.
You can be like other girls. You can get a good education in school. It's much better than listening to my tall tales.
Is that why you made the potion?
No, I've heard you say this stuff too many times! I'll go wherever you go!
Aren't you going to listen to your brother? Not anymore?
No, I don't! Not when you talk about this!
I don't want to get mad at you. Please, listen to me.
I hate it when you try to act like a big brother!
Blanche, come back! It's not safe around here.
Oh boy, there she goes. Looks like you really made her mad this time.
I don't want her to become just like me... I don't want her to become a Treasure Hoarder! She'll... understand one day.
Either way, we have to find her. It's too dangerous out there.
Can I trouble you again to help me find her? I can only trust the two of you with this...
She's family, isn't she? Why don't you do it yourself?
I... I still need to wrap this potion stuff up...
#Still thinking about your blasted potions, huh? Bah. Paimon's got nothing to say to you. {NICKNAME}, let's go find Blanche.
There you are.
#*sob* {NICKNAME}, Paimon... He's trying to kick me out again...!
He's not.
Why isn't he here, then?
Well...
He must be upset that I'm always so clingy. But I just want to be with him. What's wrong with that?
Well, he's doing this because he loves you. Don't you think he must really regret becoming a Treasure Hoarder?
But I don't mind! He was already a Treasure Hoarder when he found me!
When he found you?
He said he saw me crying on the side of the road when he was out scavenging one day, so he took me in. That was before I could speak and remember things.
In that case, can't I just become a Treasure Hoarder, too? Why won't he let me? He's so full of himself!
A Treasure Hoarder... Well... Maybe...
Anyway, let's go back first so he can stop fretting.
But he's not going to change his mind, is he?
We'll talk to him. You're his family. Paimon's sure you can work something out.
I guess so. Thank you both... But please, you have to help me convince him.
Don't worry, we will. Wait, do you hear something?
Calla Lily... I must die, right?
Oh no! It's Ruthless Calla Lily!
That's my brother!
We have to save him!
I didn't think the boss would send you, Calla Lily.
Well, I didn't think you would betray us either, Bulle Fruit.
There are things that I must do...
The little brat you found, I presume?
How... did you know?
I've had countless chances to make my move, but I don't kill anyone before I figure out what's going on. Well, now I know everything.
So I must die, right?
It's good that you're ready to pay the price. You did betray the organization for her sake, after all.
Actually, I have something to say. Bulle Fruit made a mistake, sure, but shouldn't we take a vote on this?
We should have had a share in the formula that he took. That means we should have a say in this, right?
As such, I propose we put the decision to kill Bulle Fruit to a vote. After all, the minority must obey the majority, right? Isn't that how the world works?
Wolfhook! Say something! Don't you live by that rule?
Why are you so afraid of her? We're all Operatives, aren't we?
Having Wolfhook stall me... You may as well have asked a sheep to stop a wolf. Is your New Tide just tomfoolery, Zaytun Peach?
Hey, leave the New Tide out of this.
The Fruity Order exists to maintain order in the world! We must not skip the vote!
There's no need to vote.
Seriously? Did she beat you silly?
I think Wolfhook understands that my presence represents the opinions of the boss and the rest of the group.
Even if the three of us are opposed, it's three against several dozen. And yes, in a perfect world, the minority must obey the majority.
But there is one more thing, Calla Lily.
Hmm?
I've always treated everyone in the Order like family. Even Bulle Fruit. Even you.
Families do not watch one another die, whether at the hands of outsiders or one of our own.
Do you mean to say that you're abandoning your own principles?
What I'm saying is that when it comes to family, it doesn't matter who's the majority and the minority!
Looks like I went too easy on you back when you pathetically begged for your life.
I'll do whatever it takes to stay alive. But now that there are three of us, we might stand a chance.
Too cool, brother! Too cool! Is this your latest principle?
No, Bulle Fruit taught me about this. I've just never applied it until today.
So another one wants to die. Well, Zaytun Peach? Are you sure? Do you really want to betray the boss?
Stop trying to put words in my mouth! I'll explain this to the boss myself. By the way, I'm tired of your arrogance!
Also, why don't you think about your name for a moment? Is it a fruit? Are Calla Lilies fruits?
I don't even know how you managed to become one of us. In fact, you're the real traitor! You've betrayed us simply by having that name!
I'm gonna show you what for today!
I see that you don't want to live, either. Fine. The Order's cleanup starts today!
Zaytun Peach, Wolfhook, I'm happy that you still consider me family.
But... I've been a crook my whole life, and this might be my last day in this world, so please, just let me do the right thing for once.
Stay out of it. This is my problem, and I should deal with it by myself. That way, the boss won't give you any trouble, either.
Are you out of your mind? This is not the time to try to be cool!
Don't worry, I've replicated the Pure Water, so I might stand a chance.
If that's really what you want, then I'll... support you...
Sounds great. If I don't come back, please take care of my sister for me.
Let's see what you've got.
He just wants you to live a better life.

flow.stepDescription: Go toward where the sound is coming from

dialogs.text: It's my loss...
Wait! Is this for real? How is she so weak? Did my scolding affect her mentally or something? Am I even that amazing?
It is strange. She was way stronger back when she attacked me, but even a child could fight her right now...
Tell me the truth, Calla Lily! Is my potion too strong, or are you just going easy on us?
#Isn't this because of {NICKNAME}'s help?
Even if we consider that, something still doesn't feel right...
A loss is a loss. I accept my defeat.
You...
The boss won't come for you anymore.
R—Really?
That's how the boss works. I may not like Calla Lily, but if the boss sent her, then the boss won't pursue the matter no matter the outcome.
The Calla Lily who never fails has failed. Guess we're pretty good, huh? Brother.
Yeah, yeah, you're the best, if that's what you want! Either way, you'd better figure out how we're gonna explain this to the boss. Calla Lily is definitely going to tell on us.
Hurry up and ask your New Tide for solutions, then! I've been counting on it from the beginning, you know?
What New Tide? I've never even seen the New Tide! Stop being a kid! Forget it! Let's think about it after we get back.
No matter how great she is, she only has a single mouth, but we have two! It's two against one! One is completely useless when it's two against one!
Hmph. Naive idiots. I'm leaving.
Wait, Calla Lily, Zaytun Peach, Wolfhook. I have something for you.
Blanche takes out a hand-written note and hands it over.
Huh?
This is the formula for Pure Water that my brother deciphered. This belongs to all of you too...
He wronged all of you, so allow me to apologize on his behalf. I hope you can forgive him. He only did it for my sake.
Sis...
...I see.
Listen to your brother from now on, girl.
If I had a brother too, I might not have turned out this way.
Huh?
Time to go. Take care of your sister, Crappy Bulle Fruit.
See you, Blanche. Bye, Bulle Fruit. And goodbye to the two of you too.
It's finally over, right? Phew!
No, there's still my sister...
No! I don't want to talk about that...
You've got to talk, even if you're siblings.
#C'mon, you two! {NICKNAME} is right! It's always super important to talk stuff out!
We have long conversations every day, too.
Paimon's gotta touch base with her food fund, after all.
Hey! Just... let Paimon have this, would you?
Th—Then... Alright. I'll consider what my brother has to say... but I just... I just don't want to be separated from him.
You won't truly be apart.
Indeed, we'll never truly be apart. It's just that you will experience many things while growing up, and we've all got to learn to live independently.
F—Fine, but then, you've gotta teach me...
Of course. I'll stay with you until you can stand on your own two feet.
It's a deal, then!
Alright! So what do you plan to do now?
I haven't figured that out yet. Anyway, Step One is to send a copy of the formula to the new Fontaine Research Institute. It can be considered their inheritance, after all. Haha!
I might try my luck at the Fortress of Meropide after that. Pure Water sells quite well over there. I mean, regardless of what Blanche decides to do, one simply can't do without Mora.
The clock's ticking. It's time for us to leave.
#Are we in that much of a hurry? I wanted to cook for {NICKNAME} and Paimon.
It's alright, we'll meet again.
A—Alright. If you're too busy, I'll write to the Adventurers' Guild, so don't forget to pick it up!
We will! Safe travels!
#Farewell, {NICKNAME}! See you, Paimon! And safe travels to you too!
Phew! Gotta say, Paimon does feel a bit sad to see 'em go, but we've done something very meaningful, huh? Paimon's suddenly filled with confidence toward our future journeys, in fact.
What sort of confidence?
You thought of your family just now, right? It was written all over your face.
#You'll definitely find {M#her}{F#him}, and that's what Paimon's confident in! You should have confidence in it too!
#When we see {M#her}{F#him}, Paimon will help you talk {M#her}{F#him} around. After all, {M#she}{F#he} only has a single mouth, but we have two! It's two against one!
Remember, New Tide said that one is completely useless when it's two against one!
Don't pick up that nonsense.
You truly are the Trendy Flyer.

She's family, isn't she? Why don't you do it yourself?
I... I still need to wrap this potion stuff up...
#Still thinking about your blasted potions, huh? Bah. Paimon's got nothing to say to you. {NICKNAME}, let's go find Blanche.
There you are.
#*sob* {NICKNAME}, Paimon... He's trying to kick me out again...!
He's not.
Why isn't he here, then?
Well...
He must be upset that I'm always so clingy. But I just want to be with him. What's wrong with that?
Well, he's doing this because he loves you. Don't you think he must really regret becoming a Treasure Hoarder?
But I don't mind! He was already a Treasure Hoarder when he found me!
When he found you?
He said he saw me crying on the side of the road when he was out scavenging one day, so he took me in. That was before I could speak and remember things.
In that case, can't I just become a Treasure Hoarder, too? Why won't he let me? He's so full of himself!
A Treasure Hoarder... Well... Maybe...
Anyway, let's go back first so he can stop fretting.
But he's not going to change his mind, is he?
We'll talk to him. You're his family. Paimon's sure you can work something out.
I guess so. Thank you both... But please, you have to help me convince him.
Don't worry, we will. Wait, do you hear something?
Calla Lily... I must die, right?
Oh no! It's Ruthless Calla Lily!
That's my brother!
We have to save him!
He just wants you to live a better life.
I didn't think the boss would send you, Calla Lily.
Well, I didn't think you would betray us either, Bulle Fruit.
There are things that I must do...
The little brat you found, I presume?
How... did you know?
I've had countless chances to make my move, but I don't kill anyone before I figure out what's going on. Well, now I know everything.
So I must die, right?
It's good that you're ready to pay the price. You did betray the organization for her sake, after all.
Actually, I have something to say. Bulle Fruit made a mistake, sure, but shouldn't we take a vote on this?
We should have had a share in the formula that he took. That means we should have a say in this, right?
As such, I propose we put the decision to kill Bulle Fruit to a vote. After all, the minority must obey the majority, right? Isn't that how the world works?
Wolfhook! Say something! Don't you live by that rule?
Why are you so afraid of her? We're all Operatives, aren't we?
Having Wolfhook stall me... You may as well have asked a sheep to stop a wolf. Is your New Tide just tomfoolery, Zaytun Peach?
Hey, leave the New Tide out of this.
The Fruity Order exists to maintain order in the world! We must not skip the vote!
There's no need to vote.
Seriously? Did she beat you silly?
I think Wolfhook understands that my presence represents the opinions of the boss and the rest of the group.
Even if the three of us are opposed, it's three against several dozen. And yes, in a perfect world, the minority must obey the majority.
But there is one more thing, Calla Lily.
Hmm?
I've always treated everyone in the Order like family. Even Bulle Fruit. Even you.
Families do not watch one another die, whether at the hands of outsiders or one of our own.
Do you mean to say that you're abandoning your own principles?
What I'm saying is that when it comes to family, it doesn't matter who's the majority and the minority!
Looks like I went too easy on you back when you pathetically begged for your life.
I'll do whatever it takes to stay alive. But now that there are three of us, we might stand a chance.
Too cool, brother! Too cool! Is this your latest principle?
No, Bulle Fruit taught me about this. I've just never applied it until today.
So another one wants to die. Well, Zaytun Peach? Are you sure? Do you really want to betray the boss?
Stop trying to put words in my mouth! I'll explain this to the boss myself. By the way, I'm tired of your arrogance!
Also, why don't you think about your name for a moment? Is it a fruit? Are Calla Lilies fruits?
I don't even know how you managed to become one of us. In fact, you're the real traitor! You've betrayed us simply by having that name!
I'm gonna show you what for today!
I see that you don't want to live, either. Fine. The Order's cleanup starts today!
Zaytun Peach, Wolfhook, I'm happy that you still consider me family.
But... I've been a crook my whole life, and this might be my last day in this world, so please, just let me do the right thing for once.
Stay out of it. This is my problem, and I should deal with it by myself. That way, the boss won't give you any trouble, either.
Are you out of your mind? This is not the time to try to be cool!
Don't worry, I've replicated the Pure Water, so I might stand a chance.
If that's really what you want, then I'll... support you...
Sounds great. If I don't come back, please take care of my sister for me.
Let's see what you've got.
Her legs! Go for the legs!
Calla Lily! Over here! C'mon, it's me you want! Over here!
Go for her head! Come on! The head!
Freeze her! Nice!

questNarration.text: You fall, fall, and fall in the darkness... Until you finally hear a splash!
Coldness, dampness, stiffness, and dizziness assault you, but your consciousness begins to drift away.
Like ashen coral, you quietly sink into the lifeless depths of the ocean...
Go for her head! Come on! The head!
